```
Stack trace

--- End of stack trace from previous location ---
```

The bug is a race in SoundPlayer.cs

LoadStream here ends up awaiting the test stream
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L284-L290
assigning the task to `_copyTask`
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L323

Immediately after that, it waits on `_semaphore`, which in this test times out immediately (1ms). On the timeout, it calls `CancelLoad()` which signals the CancelationTokenSource.
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L235-L237
it then calls CleanupStreamData() which sets `_lastLoadException` to null:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L172-L177

meanwhile the copy task is awaiting the test stream
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L496
which is canceled and the exception is caught here and turned into an AsyncCompletedEventArgs which is then posted back to the original thread:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1dc8dfa0058396495203e18ddc7f8a632d72c165/src/libraries/System.Windows.Extensions/src/System/Media/SoundPlayer.cs#L514-L528

The bug is that it's copying the field `_lastLoadException` into the ACEA but that gets cleared in a race with CleanupStreamData() . It should probably use the local.

The same bug exists for the two sub tests above.

review_comments: I'm not sure it's necessary to set _lastLoadException here unless there actually was an exception. However to minimise the change, it still sets null as it did before.
